source_carrier.name: Theta_perp
source_carrier.typing: theta, pi_source, sqrt(3) and source arc length are source-compatibility quantities only

target_carrier.name: E_r
target_carrier.type: AL canonical Enterprise native elementary-turn cycle
target_carrier.target_selection: already frozen by AL; no source quantity selects or retunes E_r

brc_fibers.closed_fiber: F_(r,k) is the AM source angular arc between the rays through p_(r,k) and p_(r,k+1)
brc_fibers.boundary_ties: neighboring closed fibers overlap only on common endpoint rays; these have zero source arc measure
brc_fibers.cyclic_order: inherited from AM and preserved by D6

cumulative_count.definition: N_r(theta)=number of canonical first-sector turns completed from the sector axis up to source angle theta, using the right-continuous step convention
cumulative_count.vertex_value: at the nth sector vertex p_n, N_r(theta(p_n))=n
cumulative_count.tie_irrelevance: changing left/right convention at finitely many vertex rays changes N_r by at most 1 and does not affect N_r/r or weak limits

normalized_measures.exact_source_measure: equivalently retain the normalized source arc measure uniformly on each closed fiber; midpoint embedding is used only for weak-limit comparison
